UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with points, badges, and civic stats

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth identifier of the user

reportedCount.description: Number of issues reported by this user

verifiedCount.description: Number of issues verified by this user

resolvedCount.description: Number of issues resolved that this user reported

role.description: Role of the user in the civic platform

CivicIssue.title: CivicIssue
CivicIssue.description: A reported civic issue like potholes, leaks, streetlights, etc.

title.description: A short, descriptive title of the issue

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the issue location

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the issue location

reportedBy.description: Auth UID of the reporter user

reportedByName.description: Cached display name of the reporter

reportedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when reported

verificationsCount.description: Total number of citizens who verified this issue

verifiedBy.description: Array of user UIDs who verified this issue

imageUrl.description: Optional URL to photo evidence of the issue

voiceUrl.description: Optional URL to voice recording explaining the issue

severity.description: AI-calculated risk and hazard rating from 1 (minor) to 5 (critical)

severityRationale.description: Detailed physical explanation for why this severity was assigned

hazards.description: Identified immediate physical hazards and environmental risks

aiConfidence.description: AI analysis model confidence rating (0 to 1)

aiSummary.description: AI synthesized brief overview of the reported condition

department.description: Municipal department responsible for fixing the issue

officialResponse.description: Official municipal response or dispatch logs

officialResponseAt.description: Unix timestamp when official response was logged

DailyDigest.title: DailyDigest
DailyDigest.description: Compiled daily summary of civic issues

text.description: The Markdown summary of the day's issues

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when compiled

currentWeekId.description: String ID of the current week (e.g. 2026-W26)

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when reset

issues/{issueId}.description: Active public issues tracked by citizens
